# Set Up

```{r setup}
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(readxl)
library(janitor)

capricorn_dir <- "Z:/CAPriCORN_raw_ds/CAPriCORN"  # Read Data
output_folder <- '//cri-rss.cri.uchicago.edu/chess-lab/staff/rbaccile/Matt/output/'

eligible_patients_path <- file.path(
  output_folder,
  "dataset_1_eligible_patients.csv"
)

prescribing_path <- file.path(
  capricorn_dir,
  "Prescribing.csv"
)

dispensing_path <- file.path(
  capricorn_dir,
  "Dispensing.csv"
)

lt4_rxcui_path <- file.path(
  capricorn_dir,
  "LT4_RxCUI_short.xlsx"
)

lt4_ndc_path <- file.path(
  capricorn_dir,
  "LT4_NDC_short.xlsx"
)

output_path <- file.path(
  output_folder,
  "dataset_3_LT4_prescription_list.csv"
)
```

### Helper Functions

```{r helper-functions}
normalize_id <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  
  x <- iconv(
    x,
    from = "",
    to = "UTF-8",
    sub = ""
  )
  
  x <- stringr::str_trim(x)
  x[x == ""] <- NA_character_
  
  x
}

normalize_rxcui <- function(x) {
  x %>%
    normalize_id() %>%
    str_replace("\\.0+$", "")
}

normalize_ndc <- function(x) {
  x %>%
    normalize_id() %>%
    str_replace_all("[^0-9]", "")
}

parse_mixed_date <- function(x) {
  parsed_date <- suppressWarnings(
    parse_date_time(
      as.character(x),
      orders = c(
        "ymd HMS",
        "ymd HM",
        "ymd",
        "mdy HMS",
        "mdy HM",
        "mdy",
        "dmy HMS",
        "dmy HM",
        "dmy"
      ),
      tz = "UTC",
      quiet = TRUE
    )
  )

  as.Date(parsed_date)
}
```

## Read Data

```{r eligible-patients}
eligible_patients <- readRDS(paste0(output_folder, 'dataset_1_cohort.Rds'))
```

Eligible patients: 549,729

## Read LT4 RxCUI List

```{r lt4-rxcui-list}
lt4_rxcui_raw <- read_xlsx(
  lt4_rxcui_path,
  col_types = "text"
) %>%
  clean_names()

lt4_rxcui <- lt4_rxcui_raw %>%
  select(rxcui) %>%
  unlist(use.names = FALSE) %>%
  normalize_rxcui() %>%
  discard(is.na) %>%
  unique()

cat(
  "Unique LT4 RxCUI codes:",
  length(lt4_rxcui),
  "\n"
)
```

Unique LT4 RxCUI codes: 715

## Read LT4 NDC List

```{r lt4-ndc-list}
lt4_ndc_raw <- read_xlsx(
  lt4_ndc_path,
  col_types = "text"
) %>%
  clean_names()

lt4_ndc <- lt4_ndc_raw %>%
  transmute(
    ndc = productndc %>%
      str_remove("^\\*") %>%
      str_replace_all("[^0-9]", "")
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(ndc), ndc != "") %>%
  distinct() %>%
  pull(ndc)

cat(
  "Unique LT4 product NDC codes:",
  length(lt4_ndc),
  "\n"
)
```

Unique LT4 NDC codes: 566

## Define LT4 Medication Names

```{r lt4-name-pattern}
lt4_name_pattern <- regex(
  paste(
    c(
      "levothyroxine",
      "synthroid",
      "levoxyl",
      "tirosint",
      "unithroid",
      "euthyrox",
      "ermeza",
      "thyquidity"
    ),
    collapse = "|"
  ),
  ignore_case = TRUE
)
```

# Read and filter prescribing records

```{r prescribing-records}
prescribing_lt4 <- read_csv(
  prescribing_path,
  col_select = c(
    STUDY_ID,
    RXNORM_CUI,
    RAW_RX_NDC,
    RAW_RX_MED_NAME,
    RX_ORDER_DATE,
    RX_DOSE_ORDRED,
    RX_DOSE_ORDRED_UNIT
  ),
  col_types = cols(.default = col_character()),
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  transmute(
    cap_id = normalize_id(STUDY_ID),

    rxnorm_cui = normalize_rxcui(
      RXNORM_CUI
    ),

    rxnorm_ndc = normalize_ndc(
      RAW_RX_NDC
    ),

    rx_name = normalize_id(
      RAW_RX_MED_NAME
    ),

    rx_date = parse_mixed_date(
      RX_ORDER_DATE
    ),

    rx_dose = normalize_id(
      RX_DOSE_ORDRED
    ),

    rx_dose_unit = normalize_id(
      RX_DOSE_ORDRED_UNIT
    ),

    record_source = "prescribing"
  ) %>%
  semi_join(
    eligible_patients,
    by = "cap_id"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    matched_rxcui = (
      !is.na(rxnorm_cui) &
        rxnorm_cui %in% lt4_rxcui
    ),

    matched_ndc = (
      !is.na(rxnorm_ndc) &
        rxnorm_ndc %in% lt4_ndc
    ),

    matched_name = (
      !is.na(rx_name) &
        str_detect(rx_name, lt4_name_pattern)
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(
    matched_rxcui |
      matched_ndc |
      matched_name
  )

cat(
  "LT4 prescribing records:",
  nrow(prescribing_lt4),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Patients with an LT4 prescribing record:",
  n_distinct(prescribing_lt4$cap_id),
  "\n"
)
```

LT4 prescribing records: 19,968,609

Patients with an LT4 prescribing record: 329,094

# Read and Filter Dispensing Records

```{r dispensing-records}
dispensing_lt4 <- read_csv(
  dispensing_path,
  col_select = c(
    STUDY_ID,
    DISPENSE_DATE,
    NDC,
    DISPENSE_DOSE_DISP,
    DISPENSE_DOSE_DISP_UNIT
  ),
  col_types = cols(.default = col_character()),
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  transmute(
    cap_id = normalize_id(STUDY_ID),
    rxnorm_cui = NA_character_,
    rxnorm_ndc = normalize_ndc(NDC),
    rx_name = NA_character_,
    rx_date = parse_mixed_date(DISPENSE_DATE),
    rx_dose = normalize_id(DISPENSE_DOSE_DISP),
    rx_dose_unit = normalize_id(DISPENSE_DOSE_DISP_UNIT),
    record_source = "dispensing"
  ) %>%
  semi_join(
    eligible_patients,
    by = "cap_id"
  ) %>%
    filter(str_starts(rxnorm_ndc, regex(paste0("^(", paste(lt4_ndc, collapse = "|"), ")"))))%>%
mutate(
    matched_rxcui = FALSE,
    matched_name = FALSE
  )

cat(
  "LT4 dispensing records:",
  nrow(dispensing_lt4),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Patients with an LT4 dispensing record:",
  n_distinct(dispensing_lt4$cap_id),
  "\n"
)
```

```{r combine-records}
dataset_3_lt4 <- bind_rows(
  prescribing_lt4,
  dispensing_lt4
) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(cap_id),
    !is.na(rx_date)
  ) %>%
  distinct(
    cap_id,
    rxnorm_cui,
    rxnorm_ndc,
    rx_name,
    rx_date,
    rx_dose,
    rx_dose_unit,
    record_source,
    .keep_all = TRUE
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    cap_id,
    rx_date,
    record_source
  )

cat(
  "Final Dataset 3 rows:",
  nrow(dataset_3_lt4),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Unique patients in Dataset 3:",
  n_distinct(dataset_3_lt4$cap_id),
  "\n"
)
```

```{r}
'%not_in%' <- Negate(`%in%`)
combination_meds <- dataset_3_lt4 %>% filter(rx_name %like% "LEVOTHYROXINE-LIOTHYRONINE" |
                                            rx_name %like% "liotrix")
dataset_3_lt4 <- dataset_3_lt4[dataset_3_lt4$cap_id %not_in% combination_meds$cap_id,]

tibble(
  source = c("prescribing", "dispensing"),
  rows = c(
    nrow(prescribing_lt4),
    nrow(dispensing_lt4)
  ),
  unique_patients = c(
    n_distinct(prescribing_lt4$cap_id),
    n_distinct(dispensing_lt4$cap_id)
  )
)
```

```{r qa-summary}
eligible_patients_qa <- read_csv(
  paste0(output_folder, "dataset_1_eligible_patients.csv"),
  col_select = cap_id,
  col_types = cols(cap_id = col_character()),
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  mutate(
    cap_id = normalize_id(cap_id)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(cap_id)) %>%
  distinct(cap_id)

qa_summary <- tibble(
  rows = nrow(dataset_3_lt4),
  
  unique_patients = n_distinct(
    dataset_3_lt4$cap_id
  ),
  
  eligible_patients = nrow(
    eligible_patients_qa
  ),
  
  eligible_without_lt4 = eligible_patients_qa %>%
    anti_join(
      dataset_3_lt4 %>% distinct(cap_id),
      by = "cap_id"
    ) %>%
    nrow(),
  
  missing_rx_date = sum(
    is.na(dataset_3_lt4$rx_date)
  ),
  
  missing_rx_name = sum(
    is.na(dataset_3_lt4$rx_name)
  ),
  
  missing_rxcui = sum(
    is.na(dataset_3_lt4$rxnorm_cui)
  ),
  
  missing_ndc = sum(
    is.na(dataset_3_lt4$rxnorm_ndc)
  ),
  
  missing_dose = sum(
    is.na(dataset_3_lt4$rx_dose)
  )
)

qa_summary
```

```{r source-summary}
source_summary <- dataset_3_lt4 %>%
  group_by(record_source) %>%
  summarise(
    rows = n(),
    unique_patients = n_distinct(cap_id),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

source_summary
```

```{r match-method-summary}
match_method_summary <- dataset_3_lt4 %>%
  summarise(
    matched_by_rxcui = sum(
      matched_rxcui,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    
    matched_by_ndc = sum(
      matched_ndc,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    
    matched_by_name = sum(
      matched_name,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    
    matched_only_by_name = sum(
      matched_name &
        !matched_rxcui &
        !matched_ndc,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  )

match_method_summary
```

```{r duplicate-check}

    rx_dose,
    rx_dose_unit,
```
